provenance.paper_title: Endowing Embodied Agents with Spatial Reasoning Capabilities for Vision-and-Language Navigation

evidence.paraphrase: Stores experienced paths, topological maps and coordinate maps during exploration. retrieves topological maps and historical trajectories; exact matches can reuse paths.

Spatial representation updates during real-world navigation. For BrainNav, this specifically supports relinking or reindexing of stored items of trajectory / map memory.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are deliberately linked or jointly consumed by downstream reasoning, generation, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (trajectory / map memory) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, relinking or reindexing of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
